# build a valid maximal plan with 22 flows, 64 nodes, paths 9, run counts; benefit values created via runs/time
random.seed(1)
def mk(trial):
 nn=64;nodes=['n%02d'%i for i in range(nn)];caps={x:random.randint(0,22) for x in nodes}
 flows=[];offers={}
 for i in range(22):
  path=random.sample(nodes,9)
  H=12; kinds='K'+'D'*6+'ZT'+'Q' # len? 1+1+6+1+1+1=11; need H12 add K
  kinds='K'+'D'*6+'ZKQ'+'T' # 1+6+1+1+1+1=11

  kinds='K'+'D'*6+'ZTQK' # 1+6+1+1+1+1=11
  H=12; kinds+='K' #12, oneQ/T, D6,4+6=10<12
  template=bytes(random.randrange(256) for _ in range(H)).hex()
  fid='f%02d'%i;flows.append({'id':fid,'path':path,'template':template,'kinds':kinds})
  # make eligible run big
  hdr=bytearray(random.randrange(256) for _ in range(H));tb=bytes.fromhex(template)

   if ch=='K':hdr[j]=tb[j]

 return {'mode':'plan','capacities':caps,'flows':flows,'warmup':0,'pinned':[],'offers':offers}
